question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: As the London Olympics of 2012 came to an end, it left behind unforgettable moments and incredible athletic feats. Among all, the battle between Michael Phelps and Usain Bolt stood out. Phelps, a legendary swimmer, added to his already glorious career, while Bolt redefined the meaning of (a) -------. They had also amazed the world in the Beijing Games, but in London, they truly cemented their places in Olympic history. Phelps became the most decorated Olympian ever, with a total of 22 medals. Bolt, on the other hand, became the first athlete to win the 100 and 200-meter races in two back-to-back Olympics. He also earned (b) ------- gold medals in six finals, including relays. His performance in the 100-meter dash, clocking 9.63 seconds, set a new (c) ------- record. While Phelps announced his retirement from competitive swimming after London, Bolt hinted at continuing and possibly moving into other events like the 400 meters. This raised a (d) -------: who really had the better Olympics in 2012? Phelps won four golds and two silvers in what he called his last Games. Bolt, still only 25, might not have finished his Olympic journey yet. While Phelps was already a legend, Bolt claimed that he (e) ------- one. ■■■ ■■■
